metadata.extractionPriority: Create screens in order listed for minimal dependency issues

screens.name: DashboardScreen
screens.purpose: Main dashboard with KPI cards, trend charts, category breakdown, complaint aging, and recent complaints table

internalFunctions.name: getXAxisInterval
internalFunctions.purpose: Determine interval for X-axis labels based on data length

screens.notes: Uses TREND_DATA and DASHBOARD_DATA keyed by dateRange. Contains complex chart rendering with multiple line series. Includes complaint aging bracket logic.

internalState.dateRange: tracks selected date range for filtering all metrics
internalState.oldestnew: filtered and sorted list of oldest new complaints
internalState.recentComplaints: 5 most recent complaints sorted by age

screens.name: ComplaintsScreen
screens.purpose: Searchable, filterable complaints list with sorting, pagination, and multi-select

internalFunctions.name: toggleSort
internalFunctions.purpose: Handle sort key and direction toggle

internalFunctions.name: toggleAll
internalFunctions.purpose: Toggle all complaints on current page

screens.notes: Complex filtering with useMemo optimization. Supports multi-select (currently disabled in UI). Sortable by ID, Customer, Subject, Category, Dealer, AssignedTo, Status, Age.

internalState.paged: slice of filtered list for current page

screens.name: NewComplaintScreen
screens.purpose: Multi-step accordion form to register new customer complaints

stateManagement.useEffect: Multiple effects to auto-unlock steps when sections complete

internalComponents.name: AccordionSection
internalComponents.props: title, step, newSteps, onToggle, children, complete

internalComponents.name: VehicleSelect
internalComponents.purpose: Searchable vehicle selector with add-new capability

internalFunctions.name: handleSelectCustomer
internalFunctions.purpose: Pre-populate customer details when customer is selected

internalFunctions.name: handleSubmit
internalFunctions.purpose: Validate form and show success state

internalFunctions.name: resetForm
internalFunctions.purpose: Clear all form fields back to initial state

screens.notes: Contains two internal components (AccordionSection, VehicleSelect) that should be extracted as local exports. Three-step form with progressive unlock. Shows success screen after submission. Agent list is filtered by dealer.

screens.name: ComplaintDetailsScreen
screens.purpose: Full complaint view with timeline, customer info, status management, and action panels (note, call, email)

internalFunctions.name: addEntry
internalFunctions.purpose: Add new timeline entry with timestamp

internalFunctions.name: handleDropdownStatusChange
internalFunctions.purpose: Handle status changes with modal prompts for Resolved/Closed

internalFunctions.name: handleResolve
internalFunctions.purpose: Mark complaint as resolved with summary

internalFunctions.name: handleReopen
internalFunctions.purpose: Reopen a closed complaint with reason

internalFunctions.name: handleClose
internalFunctions.purpose: Close complaint with summary and awaiting flag

screens.notes: Large component managing complaint lifecycle. Includes inline modal rendering for Resolve, Close, Reopen. Uses TimelineList component for rendering activity feed. Supports rich text editing and email composition.

internalState.base: complaint found by ID or first complaint

screens.name: ReportsScreen
screens.purpose: Analytics dashboard with KPI cards, trend charts (area), category distribution (pie), dealer performance, and agent performance table

stateManagement.useEffect: Reset agent page on date range change

internalFunctions.name: exportCSV
internalFunctions.purpose: Generate and download CSV of complaints

screens.notes: Uses REPORTS_DATA indexed by date range. Includes complex custom Recharts tooltip for stacked bar chart. Contains gradient definitions for area chart. Implements agent performance table with SLA indicators.

screens.name: SettingsScreen
screens.purpose: Admin settings for managing categories, statuses, users, and dealers with role-based access control
screens.notes: Includes permission checking - shows access denied if user lacks canViewSettings permission. Four tabs with pagination for categories, users, and dealers. Statuses tab has no pagination. Local state for initial data arrays.

screens.name: TopBar
screens.purpose: Header component with title, subtitle, dark mode toggle, and notification bell with dropdown panel
screens.functionSignature: function TopBar({ title, subtitle, notifications, onNavigate, onMarkRead, darkMode, onToggleDark })

internalComponents.name: NotificationPanel
internalComponents.purpose: Dropdown showing unread and read notifications
internalComponents.note: Currently nested, should be extracted and imported

screens.notes: Existing file at src/app/modules/layout/TopBar.tsx. Contains NotificationPanel component that should be extracted to NotificationPanel.tsx or kept as internal export.
screens.extractionNotes: Update imports and move NotificationPanel if extracting separately

screens.name: Sidebar
screens.purpose: Collapsible navigation sidebar with menu items and role-based access
screens.functionSignature: function Sidebar({ screen, collapsed, onCollapse, onNavigate })
screens.notes: Existing file. Uses NAV_ITEMS constant and ROLE_PERMISSIONS for access control. Collapsible state managed by parent.
screens.extractionNotes: Verify imports of ROLE_PERMISSIONS, SSO_USER, and NAV_ITEMS from constants

phase1: Extract all constants to constants.ts and utils.ts
Extract all shared components to components/shared.tsx
Update TopBar and Sidebar with new imports
phase3: Extract NewComplaintScreen with internal components (AccordionSection, VehicleSelect)
phase4: Extract SettingsScreen with local initial data
Update App.tsx to import all modules and render screens
phase5: Update all imports across extracted files
Verify all data flows and props

ComplaintsScreen: ALL_STATUSES, ALL_CATEGORIES, ALL_AGENTS (needed for filter options)
ComplaintDetailsScreen: All modal components (ResolveModal, CloseModal, ReopenModal, EmailThreadModal)

notes: Line numbers are based on current App.tsx structure (7300+ lines)
Some ranges may shift slightly during extraction - use function signatures as anchors
AccordionSection and VehicleSelect are internal to NewComplaintScreen - can remain as local exports or be extracted separately
Timeline-related components (buildSegments, TimelineEntry_, TimelineList, useRichEditor, NotePanel, CallPanel) should be extracted together
Modals (ResolveModal, CloseModal, ReopenModal, EmailThreadModal) should be extracted together
CustomerSearch is heavily used by NewComplaintScreen - extract to shared components
RichEditor and RichEmailEditor are used by ComplaintDetailsScreen and should be shared
CUSTOMER_DB is modified by CustomerSearch when adding new customers - location matters for mutation
All date-based filtering uses DateRange type from types.ts
SSO_USER and ROLE_PERMISSIONS are used in multiple screens for access control
NotificationPanel is nested in TopBar but should be verified/extracted if needed
